summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the outcome of its extraordinary general meeting held April 28, 2026, which approved a one-year extension of its business combination deadline to April 29, 2027. Shareholders redeemed 100,100 Class A shares for ~$12.93 per share, removing ~$1.29 million from the trust and leaving ~$18.3 million. The sponsor deposited a $100,000 monthly extension fee. There is no ongoing merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event; this is a routine SPAC trust action with no business combination announced.
